# @neural-ng/core/dialog

Import `NeuralDialog`, `NeuralDialogHeader`, `NeuralDialogBody`,
`NeuralDialogFooter`, and `NeuralDialogInitialFocus` only from
`@neural-ng/core/dialog`. Never generate their deprecated `Dialog*` aliases,
an NgModule, or a div-based replacement.

Use `neural-dialog` with optional `neural-dialog-header`,
`neural-dialog-body`, and `neural-dialog-footer`. Give every dialog an
accessible name through `ariaLabelledby` pointing to a real heading, or through
`ariaLabel`. Prefer `neuralDialogInitialFocus` on the first meaningful
interactive control.

Bind `[(open)]` for declarative state or call `show()` and `close()` from a
template reference. The optional `closed` output returns a
`NeuralDialogClose`; normal open-state binding does not require importing this
type. Do not invent `onHide` or `visibleChange` outputs.

`modal`, `closable`, `closeOnEscape`, and `dismissibleBackdrop` default to
true. Do not disable dismissal paths unless the product flow supplies an
obvious accessible alternative.

Use `fluid` for viewport-safe width and `full` only for a complete
`100vw × 100dvh` application surface. `full` takes visual precedence over
`fluid`.

Set `showFullScreenButton` to render the localized maximize/minimize action
immediately before close. Observe `fullChange` when application state must
track user toggles. Use `enterFullScreenLabel` and `exitFullScreenLabel` only
to override locale messages.

For headless rendering, set `unstyled` and pass typed `classes`. Structural
classes remain. Do not assume Neural Icons is installed.

Canonical example:

```html
<neural-button (clicked)="dialog.show()">Open settings</neural-button>
<neural-dialog #dialog ariaLabelledby="settings-title">
  <neural-dialog-header>
    <h2 id="settings-title">Settings</h2>
  </neural-dialog-header>
  <neural-dialog-body>
    <input neuralDialogInitialFocus aria-label="Workspace name" />
  </neural-dialog-body>
  <neural-dialog-footer>
    <button type="button" (click)="dialog.close()">Done</button>
  </neural-dialog-footer>
</neural-dialog>
```
